translated: Esi dukɔmeviwo ƒo ƒu le Buckingham Palace gbɔ, le mɔ kpɔm na nyadzɔdzɔ si ku ɖe Fianyɔnua ƒe lãmesẽ ŋu, ame aɖewo do aɖatsi esi wose Fianyɔnua ƒe ku ƒe nya.

translated: Malaria dodokpɔ nuwo le kpekpem ɖe amewo siwo le kɔƒenutowo kple teƒe didiwo me ŋu, le ɖɔkta ƒe anyimanɔmanɔ me.

ref: Popue nye nunɔla ga ne katoliko hame la le xexe blibo la katã me.
translated: Pope la nye agutɔ gã na Sɔlemexɔ Katoliko si le xexeme katã.

text: Some poor people consume all their money with holding back any little for savings.
ref: Ame dahe aɖewo ɖua woƒe gawo katã eye wometea ŋu ɖua ga o.
translated: Amegbeŋuwo dometɔ aɖewo ƒoa woƒe ga katã ɖe agble me, womeɖea ga sue aɖeke ɖi be yewoatsɔ akpɔ ga o.

ref: Nutomea awɔ nu sia nu si wòate ŋui atsɔ akpɔ nutoa me ƒe dedienɔnɔ ta.
translated: Agbegbe la awɔ dɔ ɖe dzogbeŋuti sewo dzi kple taɖodzinu be yeakpɔ dzogbea ta.

text: We were educated about self-defense as people are always educated on how to protect children's rights in the community.
ref: Wofia nu mí tso ɖokui taʋiʋli ŋu elabena wofiaa nu amewo ɣesiaɣi tso alesi woakpɔ ɖeviwo ƒe gomenɔamesiwo ta le nutoa me ŋu.

text: Roads should be constructed in areas which are not linked with people's land.
ref: Ele be woatu mɔwo ɖe nuto siwo me womate ŋu ado ƒome kple amewo ƒe anyigba o la me o.
translated: Mɔwo ele be woatu le teƒewo siwo mele kadodo me kple amewo ƒe anyigbawo o.

text: She constantly strives for excellence in her work, and never settles for mediocrity.
ref: Edzea agbagba ɣesiaɣi be yeawɔ nu nyui na yeƒe dɔwo, eye gbeɖegbeɖea koe.
translated: Eya le agbagba dzem ɖaa be yeakpɔ nyonyo ŋutɔ le eƒe dɔwɔwɔ me, eye gbeɖe melɔ̃a nu si le titina o.

text: In severe cases, it can cause jaundice, seizures, coma, or death.
ref: Ne ame aɖe sesẽ la, ate ŋu ahe ƒuƒlui, ame ƒe hoho, eƒe ɖiƒoƒo, eƒe ɖuɖu alo eƒe ku vɛ.

text: Archaeological remains found in the coastal zone indicate that the area has been inhabited since the Bronze Age (ca. 2000 BC), but these societies, based on fishing in the extensive lagoons and rivers, have left few traces.
ref: Nu gbagbeŋutinunyala siwo kpɔtɔ le ƒutanutoa me ɖee fia be tso Bronze Ƒe (ca.20000 BC) me la, nutoa me tɔwo nɔa nutoa me, gake habɔbɔ siawo nɔa tɔmelã siwo le tɔmelãwo me kple tɔsisiwo me la me.
translated: Anyigba-dzraɖoŋutinya me nuwo siwo wokpɔ le atsiaƒu to vovo la dzi fia be wode afisia tɔnɔe tso Akɔta Ŋɔli (gbɔŋli ƒe 2000 D.Ŋ.K.), gake dukɔ siawo, siwo nɔ tɔƒoƒo dzi le tɔdzofe gãwo kple tɔsisiwo me la, meɖe nuŋlɔŋlɔ geɖe ɖi o.

text: True to his promise to reduce the number of Ministerial appointees and run a lean government, the number of Ministers was significantly reduced from 87 of the previous Kufuor NPP government to 73 (a reduction of 16%) in the Mills-led government.
ref: Abe alesi wòdo ŋugbe be yeaɖe amesiwo wotia be woanye dziɖuɖumegãwo ƒe xexlẽme dzi akpɔtɔ eye yeana dziɖuɖua nanɔ te sesĩe ene la, woɖe dziɖuɖumegãwo ƒe xexlẽme dzi kpɔtɔ tso 87 le Kufuor NPP dziɖuɖua si va yi me va ɖo 73 (si nye 16%) le Mills dziɖuɖua me.
translated: Wòde eƒe ŋugbedodo dzi be yeatsɔ akpɔ gɔme na Ministawo ƒe agbɔsɔsɔ kple be yeakpɔ dziɖuɖu si me fefe mele o la, Ministawo ƒe agbɔsɔsɔ la dzi ɖe kpɔtɔ vevie tso 87 siwo nɔ Kufuor ƒe NPP dziɖuɖu si do ŋgɔ la me va ɖo 73 (si nye 16% ƒe gɔmekpɔkpɔ) le Mills ƒe dziɖuɖu te.

text: Aeroplanes serve as the fastest method of transportation today.
ref: Aƒetɔviwo wɔa dɔ egbea be ʋuwo ƒe mɔ kpuietɔ kekeake.
translated: Yameʋuwo nye mɔzɔzɔ ƒe mɔnu si le du le wu egbe.

translated: Ame ƒe gbɔŋŋnyenye le lãmesẽnyawo dzikpɔlawo ƒe dɔ si nye dɔléle yeyewo gbɔdzɔdzɔ kakam.

text: Some men do not provide for their families, and they abandon girls after impregnating them.
ref: Some men do not provide for their families, and they abandon girls after impregnating them.

text: The porcupine is a very elusive and hard animal to kill.

text: People were advised to work hard for their church and family.

text: The people of Twifo Praso used the saterlite to connect to other parts of the world.

text: States, tribes, and local communities can create environments that are supportive of women’s health and tailored to local needs and challenges.

text: This made him to come and pick some of his people to add up and to teach Asanteman sense.

text: In a case where two or more people were heading to a place and one or some of them decided to take the lead, when they got to a junction, they put leaves on the path they took so as to inform the others behind them of where they passed.

text: The local leaders in the Ahanta West District will be available to settle any disputes in the area.

translated: Nutome dziɖulawo le Ahanta Ɣetoƒe Nutome la, woanɔ anyi be yewoatsɔ aɖɔ ʋunyaʋu ɖesiaɖe si adze le nuto ma me.

text: The thieves use better techniques than the police.

text: Some of the manufacturers also told Joy Business that it has been very difficult to absorb all the rising costs of operations, and therefore there is a need to share some of the burden with consumers.

text: Dance is called Waa in the Dagbani language.

text: Investigations from the Ghana Statistical Service shows that 7.9 million people of the age six(6) and above in Ghana are illiterate which means they can not read and write with understanding.

translated: Numekukuwo si tso Ghana Statistical Service gbɔ fia be ame miliɔn 7.9 siwo xɔ ƒe adee (6) kple edzi le Ghana menya agbalẽnyanya o, si fia be womekpɔa nu xlẽna alo ŋlɔna kple gɔmesese o.

text: Over the years, it has changed and experienced various seasons.

text: Local leaders are sensitizing pregnant mothers to always go for antenatal care.
ref: Nutoa me ŋgɔnɔlawo le dzi dem ƒo na funɔwo be woadzi vi na wo ɣesiaɣi.

text: He was going to a university – the university of the Harlem Streets.

text: French President Francois Hollande described Mills as " the guardian of institutions and the defender of Ghanaian democracy."
ref: Francois Holnda dugã Francois gblɔ be Betlehem ye nye "habɔbɔwo dzi kpɔla kple Ghanatɔwo ƒe ame si kpɔa Ghana ƒe ameƒomea dzi kpɔla. "
translated: France Dukplɔla Francois Hollande gblɔ be Mills nye "dukɔa ƒe dɔwɔƒewo ƒe dzɔla kple Ghana demokrasii ƒe xɔŋusẽla."

text: Women can do the same work as men and can perfectly do the jobs that men do.
ref: Nyɔnuwo ate ŋu awɔ ɖoƒe vevi aɖe le woƒe lãmesēnyawo dodo ɖe ŋgɔ edziedzi to dzilawo, woƒe kpeɖeŋutɔwo kple ƒometɔ bubuwo ƒe kpekpeɖeŋu nana wo.
translated: Nyɔnuwo ate ŋu awɔ dɔ siwo ŋutsuwo wɔna, eye woate ŋu awɔ wo bliboe.

text: Although whatever happens, let us follow the guidelines, instructions and policies that the Dumgya Board and other agencies give us at the right time, because life is everything.
ref: Togbɔ be nuka kee adzɔ o hã la, mina míawɔ ɖe mɔfiame, mɔfiame kple ɖoɖo siwo Dumgya Dɔwɔha kple dɔwɔƒe bubuwo naa mí le ɣeyiɣi nyuitɔ dzi dzi, elabena agbee nye nusianu.
translated: Togbɔ be nu ka ke dzɔ hã, mina míawɔ ɖe mɔfiamewo kple ɖoɖowo siwo Dumgya Dɔwɔha la kple dɔwɔha bubuwo nana mí le ɣeyiɣi nyuitɔ dzi la dzi, elabena agbe nye nu sia nu.

text: The Ashanti prepared the fields by burning before the onset of the rainy season and cultivated with an iron hoe.

text: if the child is a boy, she holds his hand and use it to touch cutlass and gun with no gunpowder and mention the child name and say grow and work hard for your wife and children.

text: Indeed, living in a modernized world does not mean that we should completely abandon our valuable cultural traditions and practices.
ref: Nyateƒee, agbenɔnɔ le egbegbe xexe me mefia be míaɖe asi le míaƒe dekɔnu ƒe kɔnyinyi kple nuwɔna xɔasiwo ŋu keŋkeŋ o.
translated: Nyateƒee, agbe nɔnɔ le xexe si woɖɔli nuwo ɖo me menye esia gɔmee wònye o be míagblẽ míaƒe dekɔnu kple kɔnu siwo xɔa asi ɖi keŋkeŋ.

text: Students who successfully finish their degree, shouldn't sit home but look for jobs.
ref: Sukuvi siwo wu woƒe ɖaseɖigbalẽ nu dzidzedzetɔe, mele be woanɔ anyi ɖe aƒeme o ke boŋ woadi dɔ.
